lines.text: Jesus tells the crowds and His disciples that the scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
Jesus says to observe what they tell you, but they tie up heavy loads and will not lift a finger.
They broaden their phylacteries, love the places of honor at banquets, and love the chief seats in the courts.
Jesus says to call no one on earth your brother, and that your one Instructor is the Christ.
Jesus says the greatest among you shall be your servant, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
